title: Implement Subset Sum DP in Go
description: Implement SubsetSum(nums []int, target int) bool using 1-D bottom-up DP: return true if any subset of nums sums to target.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement SubsetSum in subsetsum.go using 1-D DP:
- Create dp []bool of length target+1; set dp[0]=true
- For each num in nums: iterate j from target down to num; set dp[j] = dp[j] || dp[j-num]
- Return dp[target]
- Edge case: if target==0, return true immediately (empty subset sums to 0)
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
